newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes flat in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes flat in light trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed almost flat at C$1.3517 (US$0.7398) from Wednesday's closing at C$1.3515 (US$0.7400) in fairly light trading, dealers said. * The currency weakened overnight after a substantial rally in the past few days, but strengthened in brisk morning trading on buying interest from Europe and U.S. investors.
"We dropped sort of 50 points in an hour and then it's traded in a 20 point range for the rest of the day," one trader said.
Dealers said there might be more weakness stemming from the Far East overnight.
They said Friday's trading would depend on U.S. non-farm payroll numbers and Canadian and U.S. unemployment statistics expected on Friday.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar rose to 1.1646 marks from Wednesday's close of 1.1643 marks and firmed to 85.99 yen from 85.54 yen.
